# 8-connectivity components of 3s
pts={(r,c) for r in range(23) for c in range(17) if grid[r][c]==3}
comps=[]
while pts:
    seed=pts.pop(); comp={seed}; stack=[seed]
    while stack:
        r,c=stack.pop()
        for dr in (-1,0,1):
            for dc in (-1,0,1):
                q=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if q in pts:
                    pts.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
    comps.append(comp)
[(sorted(c), max(x for y,x in c)) for c in comps]
